name: The referee's report
hook: Pip carded Mum at roller derby. Mum ate a Hobnob at Pip from the penalty box.
question: Pip said yes. Nell said maybe. Whose side are you on? 👀

segments.title: The referee's report
segments.sub: Pip refereed roller derby. Nell guards a museum at night. The nightclub is so loud every line is shouted.
segments.say: A first date in a nightclub so loud, every line has to be shouted.

segments.sub: Pip wanted the long way home. Nell closed the file.

segments.title: Nell is December's Botchelor.
segments.sub: She wants someone who asks a follow-up question.
segments.say: Nell is December's Botchelor. She's looking for someone who asks a follow-up question.
